'''Echo Command Center''',<ref name="CCG-Command" /> also referred to as '''Echo Command''',<ref name="CCG-Toryn">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Toryn Farr}}</ref> was the central command and war room serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="CCG-Command" /> The Command Center directed the Alliance's operations through Echo Base and across the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and its surrounding [[Hoth system/Legends|system]].<ref name="ESB" />

During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the command staff serving in Echo Command Center stayed at their posts for as long as possible, directing defense and evacuation efforts. As [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] finally breached Echo Base, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] told the remaining staff to broadcast the general evacuation code signal and to head for their [[Transport/Legends|transports]].<ref name="ESB" />
